business_scope.primary_industry_name: Private Investment Holding for High-Net-Worth Family Assets

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (Investment Chapter)
Colombia–Chile / Colombia–Mexico Tax Treaties and Bilateral Investment Protocols

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 1258 of 2008 (SAS), Law 526 of 1999 (UIAF), Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT), DIAN Resolution 000164 of 2021 (Beneficiarios Finales register), Circular Básica Jurídica of the Superintendencia de Sociedades (2021).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation of foreign corporate shareholder (if any)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry / Chamber of Commerce of jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus sworn Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney for incorporation (Poder Especial)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in country of origin or Colombian consulate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; sworn translation into Spanish

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or national ID copies of all ultimate beneficial owners and legal representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy with Apostille (for foreign documents)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Lease agreement or registered-office address contract

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signature before Colombian notary (no apostille needed)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and UBOs against the Colombian PEP Registry, UIAF lists, OFAC SDN, UN/EU consolidated sanctions, INTERPOL red notices, and World Bank debarment lists. Enhanced due diligence is required for high-risk jurisdictions, crypto activity, or public official origins. KYC files must be retained for five years under Circular Básica Jurídica and FATF standards.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) and the online virtual office of the Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be in Spanish. Foreign words must be transliterated into Spanish script or accompanied by a Spanish translation. The name must be unique, not confusingly similar to existing Colombian registrations, and the abbreviation 'S.A.S.' must be included at the end of the name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Before expiry, extension requires filing a new name-application request with the same Chamber of Commerce. If the name is rejected, the applicant may raise an administrative appeal within 10 business days before the Chamber of Commerce that issued the rejection. If the rejection is based on similarity with an existing registrant, the applicant may request homologation before the Superintendencia de Sociedades, and thereafter pursue the applicable administrative litigation remedy before the Council of State.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a SAS if the virtual office arrangement includes a physical Colombian address that is accessible for service of process and the legal representative maintains a permanent domicile. However, for a single-family office, DIAN, UBO registration, and private banks may require evidence of actual administrative presence. A co-working or 'virtual plus meeting room' arrangement is generally accepted for passive asset holding.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 25% annual likelihood for a medium-risk single-family office holding private investment assets; the risk increases to 45% if the entity applies for tax incentives, holds regulated securities, or engages in intercompany financing in Colombia.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of expedited SAS bylaws and initial authorization minutes
Commercial registration of the SAS at the Chamber of Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration fee based on authorized capital (minimum floor for no-capital SAS)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO piercing analysis and AML/CFT pre-incorporation due diligence
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External corporate counsel and compliance advisor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for Colombian SFO incorporations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of foreign constituent documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs / consular post of country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official consular or apostille fee per document (3 documents x USD 50)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and international sanctions screening subscription
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Annual per-search compliance fee at market rate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office / virtual office address (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Annual service contract at Bogotá market rate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RUT (DIAN tax ID) and UBO register filing support
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified public accountant or tax attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market professional fee for electronic filing and UBO report

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas, Articles 1, 4, 5, and 17); Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971) Articles 110-114; and Decreto 1074 de 2015 (regulatory commerce compilations), supplemented by Ley 2069 de 2020 for entrepreneurial facilitation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá acting as the commercial registry delegate integrated with the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES); authoritative corporate supervision by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument), elevated to notarial escritura pública only when real property or public-instrument contributions are made; filed through the RUES registration platform with the Matrícula Mercantil application.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital; the share capital and the fixed value of shares are freely determined by the incorporator. Contributions may be cash or in-kind and may be deferred for a term not exceeding two (2) years. No mandatory escrow or blocked-account requirement exists; paid-in contributions are credited to the company's corporate bank account.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION - [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. (Colombia) RESOLVED: 1) Constitution. The incorporation document under Law 1258 of 2008 is approved; the company is established as a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada with the corporate purpose of prudent private investment holding and family asset management. 2) Subscription. The entire authorized share capital of USD 10,000 equivalent is fully subscribed and paid in accordance with statutory terms and reflected in the accounting records. 3) Registered office. The registered office is adopted at [address], Bogota D.C., Colombia. 4) Officers. [Name] is appointed legal representative and [Name] is appointed alternate legal representative, each with full powers of administration, representation, and corporate acts. 5) Banking. The corporate bank package is approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá via the RUES virtual window (www.rue.com.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUES online portal, submit the proposed corporate name, obtain the Certificado de Homonimia, and reserve the accepted name for up to 30 calendar days. The name must incorporate the mandatory 'S.A.S.' suffix and be checked against the local and national commercial registries.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name in Spanish with the 'S.A.S.' suffix
Valid identification document (cédula or passport) of each founding shareholder
Apostilled power of attorney where a non-resident shareholder uses a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar to an existing one, submit a revised distinctive name through the same virtual form within the reservation window; no additional fee applies for the re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Incorporation Instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders and, when real property is contributed, a Colombian Notary Public (Notaría)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Sign the private incorporation instrument containing the reserved name, full by-laws, share structure, appointment of the legal representative, and registered office address. Notarial public-deed formalities are mandatory only if real estate or public-instrument assets are contributed. Non-resident shareholders must sign before a foreign notary with apostille or grant a valid power of attorney.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate (Certificado de Homonimia)
Passport or national identification of subscribers
Apostilled power of attorney for non-resident shareholders acting through a Colombian representative
Statement of contribution form (cash or in-kind valuation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary requires supplementary evidence (e.g., certified Spanish translation of a foreign shareholder document), the document can be corrected the same day; no corporate act is void if the omitted information is subsequently registered.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Chamber of Commerce (Matrícula Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (registration window under RUES and state oversigh)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed incorporation instrument together with the RUES Matrícula Mercantil registration form and pay the applicable registration rights. The Chamber opens the mercantile folio and issues the Certificado de Cámara de Comercio, which evidences legal existence of the S.A.S.
required_dossiers: Signed incorporation instrument (private document or public deed)
RUES mercantile registration form
Proof of payment of registration fees
Copy of identification of shareholders and legal representative
Certificate of the name reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues a 'requerimiento' (correction notice), the applicant must cure within ten (10) business days; incorrect data may be corrected through the update form. An adverse decision may be challenged by the recurso de reposición filed with the Chamber and by recurso de apelación before the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration at DIAN (NIT and RUT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - Sede Electrónica
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the mercantile registration, apply for the NIT through the RUT form in the DIAN virtual portal. Declare the applicable tax attributes (corporate income tax, interest deduction regime, and electronic invoicing obligations) and confirm the primary and secondary legal addresses. Finalize with the issuance of the RUT certificate.
required_dossiers: Chamber of Commerce certificate (Certificado de Cámara de Comercio)
Pre-form of RUT generated in the DIAN portal
Identification of the legal representative and shareholders
Proof of the registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN requests additional evidence of representation or address, respond via the 'Trámites' online menu within ten (10) business days; the RUT remains valid while the correction request is pending, and the tax file is automatically activated once the information is submitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Tax Registration (Registro de Industria y Comercio - ICA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda (Bogotá) or the municipal treasury of the registered municipality
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company in the local registry of industry and commerce using activity code 6430 and declare the projected gross income. The registry assigns the ICA taxpayer identifier and the complementary municipal declarations. For a passive holding company, no sectoral financial licence is triggered by this filing.
required_dossiers: RUT and NIT obtained from DIAN
Current Chamber of Commerce certificate
Lease agreement or title deed of the registered office
Projected income statement for the first fiscal year
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal treasury requires clarifications of projected revenues, present a corrected ICA form and the corresponding financial schedule within ten (10) business days; any erroneous assessment may be cured through the municipal correction process without penalties if filed proactively.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fire Safety, Occupational Health, and Premises Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos de Bogotá and the occupational risk administrator (ARL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Secure the fire safety inspection of the registered office, verify structural load compliance under the NSR-10 building code, and implement the Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) before engaging any personnel. The fire safety certificate must remain available with the corporate records.
required_dossiers: Fire safety inspection form for the office premises
Floor plan and structural occupancy certificate for the leased or owned office
Basic SG-SST programming and ARL affiliation documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire inspection identifies corrective actions, remedy the deficiencies within the timeframe stated in the inspection report (typically ten business days) and request an official re-inspection; no sanction accrues while corrective measures are pending.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for ISIC 6430; corporate supervision rests with the Superintendencia de Sociedades, while the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) has no jurisdiction because the single family office does not engage in regulated financial intermediation.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating license required; the only administrative prerequisites are the municipal Registro de Industria y Comercio (ICA) and the fire safety certificate of the registered administrative office.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) under the Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Passive, office-based investment holding company; no industrial installation, physical transformation, or resource exploitation, hence no mandatory environmental license under Decree 1076 of 2015 and ANLA Resolution 0256 of 2014.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No production or process emissions; any domestic sanitary wastewater must comply with Resolution 0631 of 2015 municipal sewer discharge limits; solid waste handling must follow the municipal waste-management rules of Bogotá; VOCs and noise from office equipment are negligible and must meet local air quality directives.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety and human-life protection certificate issued by the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos; structural adequacy for the office occupancy under NSR-10; and registration in the Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) with the corresponding ARL once staff are engaged.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales; official portal: https://www.dian.gov.co (including Muisca electronic tax filing platform)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a local S.A.S., the NIT is generated in the RUT registration process after Chamber of Commerce incorporation; foreign entities must also register through DIAN's Muisca portal. The procedure requires appointment of a local legal representative/agent, notarized and apostilled incorporation documents, power of attorney, proof of taxable nexus or representative office, and submission of the RUT form online. DIAN issues one unified 'Número de Identificación Tributaria' (NIT) used for income tax, IVA registration, customs and international trade.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or pass-through election exists for a Colombian S.A.S.; classification is mandatory. Colombia applies OECD/Hybrid Mismatch rules rather than elective entity classification, and there is no domestic election to treat a S.A.S. as fiscally transparent. Optional mechanisms are limited to group consolidation (optional for groups qualifying under Law 1819/2016) and the simplified taxation regime for small business (not applicable to a licensed-vehicle SFO).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (IVA - Impuesto sobre las Ventas)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 0 (no monetary threshold); any foreign or local juridical person performing taxable transactions in Colombia must complete RUT registration and obtain IVA status before invoicing. Simplified small-taxpayer status only affects invoicing, not the zero threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All IVA-registered persons must issue electronic invoices through DIAN-authorized platforms (Facturación Electrónica de Venta). DIAN validates each XML invoice in near-real-time via HTTPS/API, assigning a unique CUFE/CUDS cryptographic code and publication status; no physical fiscal stamp is used. The invoice and all transaction events must be sent electronically to DIAN and delivered to recipients through approved channels.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% IVA applies to exports of goods physically leaving Colombian customs territory, as well as to qualifying exports of services rendered from Colombia but used exclusively abroad by non-resident clients. For single-family office and investment custody services, the provider must evidence a contract with a foreign counterparty, beneficial use and value exclusively outside Colombia, and no relation to tangible goods delivered in Colombia. The exporter must present complete supporting documentation to DIAN and apply for refund of input IVA attributable to export sales.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) validated in DIAN's customs system, or service export declaration/electronic record where the 'export' is a service transaction.
Transport document: Bill of Lading or Airwaybill for goods; for offshore services, a signed contract with the foreign principal showing scope, fee, delivery, and exclusive use abroad.
Inward Remittance Certificate from a Colombian bank or foreign exchange intermediary evidencing collection and repatriation of export proceeds.
Certificates of supplier-to-exporter for zero-rated local input purchases used in the exported goods or services, if applicable.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN conducts direct audits of every zero-rated export, looking for fake invoices, unfilled exemptions and absent FX repatriation. A clawback or disallowed credit may occur when the export declaration is invalid, documentation incomplete, or proceeds not repatriated by the 180-day term. The exporter will be assessed 19% IVA on the full export value, plus inflationary adjustment, default interest, and the inaccuracy penalty under Tax Code Art. 648 (up to 200% of the evaded tax). Falsified export documentation or sham cross-border flows can trigger criminal tax/customs proceedings, disqualification of NIT, and monetary sanctions against the legal representative.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia, operating jointly with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia and the Comité de Cambios Internacionales for the interpretation and enforcement of Colombia's foreign-exchange regulations (Régimen Cambiario).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia maintains an administered exchange-control regime, not a full capital-control prohibition. Current-account convertibility for trade, services, interest, royalties, and ordinary income is broadly free, but all such transactions must be canalizada through local authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries. Capital-account operation is conditional: foreign direct investment and foreign loans must be registered with Banco de la República through an authorized local bank or financial intermediary. Dividend and profit remittances to non-resident investors are legally available for registered investments once Colombian corporate income tax and applicable non-resident dividend withholding tax have been settled. The main remittance hurdles are not exchange rationing or prior administrative approval, but rather mandatory foreign-investment registration, documentary proof of tax and accounting basis, tax clearance, and the domestic bank's AML/CFT source-of-funds review.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombian goods exporters are required to channel and negotiate in the local foreign-exchange market 100% of the FOB/negotiated value of their export proceeds through an authorized intermediary within the statutory deadline set by Banco de la República, generally six months from the shipment or loading date. If the foreign currency is not collected and surrendered within that period, the exporter must submit a justification and request an extension through its intermediary. Service-export receipts are equally subject to canalización under the service contract terms, and no discretionary right exists to retain export proceeds indefinitely in offshore accounts without local exchange-market surrender.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Private Banking settlement account
Operational Account / Private Banking custody account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs have low viability as the primary treasury account for a Colombian tax-resident SAS single-family office. Colombian supervisory law reserves deposit-taking and local payment intermediation to entities authorized by the Superintendencia Financiera, and an unlicensed foreign electronic-money institution cannot lawfully hold client funds or process regular COP-denominated third-party payments without a licensed local bank partner. Domestic SEDPEs (Sociedades Especializadas en Depósitos y Pagos Electrónicos) have medium viability only as a supplementary expense-management or wallet rail; they cannot provide correspondent SWIFT clearing, securities custody, capital escrow, or the full private-banking treasury infrastructure required by an SFO.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Colombian law does not categorically prohibit remote onboarding if the bank's AML/KYC framework is satisfied, but in practice a Medium-Risk-Enhanced single-family office with non-resident beneficial owners will trigger an in-person or video-enhanced senior interview mandate. Tier-one banks generally require the Colombian legal representative or a designated account signatory to attend a physical branch or private-banking appointment; non-resident directors may be onboarded remotely using apostilled and notarized powers of attorney, certified corporate registry documents, and a documented video identification call. Pure remote opening with zero physical visit is not a realistic compliance path for a multi-jurisdictional SFO structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multi-tier offshore ownership through trusts, SPVs, or foreign private foundations causing opaque beneficial ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete beneficial-ownership chart through to natural persons, certified trust deeds and SPV constitutional documents, family council or investment committee minutes, audited financial statements, a written no-nominee/no-bearer-shares certification, and a sworn source-of-wealth declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically Exposed Person (PEP) status of family members or close associates.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PEP identification forms, public-office evidence, independent negative-news database reports, enhanced due diligence questionnaires, and 12 to 24 months of bank statements and transactional evidence to corroborate legitimate sources of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unregistered prior capital contributions or mismatched foreign-investment declarations with Banco de la República.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Backdated registration and foreign-exchange declaration forms (Form 1 International Investment), bank debit memos and credit memos, board capitalization resolutions, subscription agreements, and an external auditor's confirmation reconciling equity injections.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments received from unrelated third-party accounts or unexplained abrupt wealth transfers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Funds-flow narrative, financing or shareholder-loan contracts, promissory notes, term sheets, board approvals, sworn equivalency statements, and source-of-funds bank statements covering the transaction history.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction nexus in the transaction footprint or investor domicile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Local counsel opinion, corporate purpose memoranda, tax residence certificates, double-tax-treaty analysis, beneficial-ownership information, and documented commercial or investment rationale for each high-risk nexus.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: ISIC 6430 family-office classification masking unlicensed lending, payment services, or third-party investment management.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Updated SAS bylaws and Chamber of Commerce registry certificate, written operating rules confirming activity is restricted to single-family asset management, no customer-facing financial services, and executed third-party investment-management agreements where external managers are used.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital must be routed through a locally authorized Colombian foreign-exchange intermediary. The compliant protocol is: (i) non-resident shareholder wires USD or other foreign currency to the SFO's designated capital-escrow account at the tier-one bank using SWIFT MT103 or MT202 with a purpose code identifying foreign direct investment/equity subscription; (ii) the remitter completes Banco de la República's foreign-investment registration and the local bank files the corresponding exchange declaration form (Declaración de Cambio Formulario 1) in the investor's name; (iii) the receiving bank verifies the beneficial owner, source of funds, and corporate authorization before any conversion to COP; and (iv) the SFO maintains a monthly reconciliation between the capital account, registered foreign investment file, and tax basis to avoid late-registration penalties.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade and investment disbursements must be canalizada through the authorized Colombian intermediary. The preferred clearing rails are SWIFT MT103 for final commercial payments, SWIFT MT202 COV for correspondent clearing, and documentary/commercial letters of credit subject to UCP600 for physical trade settlements. The bank requires the related exchange declaration, underlying commercial contract and invoice, DIAN customs declaration where goods are involved, board resolution or investment-committee approval, and, where applicable, tax withholding certificates and evidence that the corresponding foreign-investment registration remains current.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/COP forward contracts executed with a locally authorized bank or financial intermediary
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts used where physical USD/COP delivery is not available or not desired for the hedging structure
Cross-currency swaps (USD-COP) supported by documented underlying commercial or financial exposure and registered through the mandatory canalización channel

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Annual Commercial Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce / Registro Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January – 31 March each calendar year; no anniversary extension for S.A.S. entities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharge of 5% per month or fraction of the renewal value, capped at 100%; prolonged non-renewal triggers inactive registry status, loss of business registration, and administrative strike-off of the S.A.S.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return – Formulario 110 (Cédula General / Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in the April–August DIAN filing window following the 31 December year-end; exact due date fixed by last two digits of the NIT (FY2024 return: 8 April – 7 August 2025)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine of 5% per month over the tax payable, generally capped at 20% for voluntary late submission; monthly default interest; persistent non-filing triggers DIAN estimated assessment and suspension of the RUT.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO Annual Confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually aligned with the income-tax filing window (approximately April–August) per DIAN calendar; ad-hoc update required promptly upon qualifying ownership or control changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Asset-scaled fines for missing or inaccurate beneficiary disclosure; blocked issuance of tax certificates and refunds; penalties for false UBO declarations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena (Annual Exogenous / Third-Party Information Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Mid-May following the tax year-end (typically 8–15 May in the DIAN annual calendar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of up to 1% of the unreported or underreported amount, subject to statutory minimums; non-submission blocks annual declaration processing and pending tax refunds.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Depósito de Estados Financieros (Deposit of Annual Financial Statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of shareholder approval of the annual financial statements; approval must be held by 31 March, making 30 April the practical annual deposit deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure blocks the March commercial-registry renewal; directors become jointly liable for damages; continued omission exposes the company to registry inactivation and strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Reunión de Accionistas / Aprobación de Estados Financieros (Annual Shareholders' Meeting)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate governance action; minutes recorded in the corporate minute book (not filed with a government agency)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months of the 31 December fiscal year-end, i.e., by 31 March each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors' personal liability for failure to convene; inability to complete the deposit of financial statements and registry renewal; nullity of improperly approved dividends.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Anual del Impuesto de Industria y Comercio (ICA – Municipal Annual Filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipal treasury / Secretaría de Hacienda (local jurisdiction)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in April (typically 15–25 April) following the prior tax year; exact date and municipal rules vary by district
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Municipal late-filing fine of up to 5% per month on the declared tax, plus 12% annual default interest; municipal collection embargoes and withholding certifications denied.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Colombian S.A.S. entities must appoint a statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) when total assets exceed 5,000 times the applicable legal monthly minimum wage (approx. COP 6.5 billion for FY2024), when the entity employs more than 50 workers, or when the company is a parent or controlled entity subject to consolidation or public-interest rules; a single-family-office holding below these thresholds is not statutorily compelled to appoint an auditor, although local private-banking counterparties commonly require an independent audit as a credit condition.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia (Decreto 2483/2018): Grupo 2 (NIIF para las PYMES / IFRS for SMEs) is the applicable framework for a private single-family-office holding; Grupo 1 (full IFRS) applies if the entity is listed, of public interest, holds certain regulated activity, or exceeds the asset/employee thresholds for Grupo 1 classification; financial statements are prepared in COP with comparative prior-year figures.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each year the S.A.S. must electronically confirm its ultimate beneficial owners (natural persons holding, directly or indirectly, 5% or more of capital/voting rights or exercising control) through the DIAN RBF portal during the annual tax-filing window; any shareholding transfer or control change occurring since the last confirmation must be accurately reflected in the next annual confirmation and should be updated ad hoc in the RBF system where the change is material; failure to update upon transfer creates independent fines and impairs the company's clean tax-status certificate.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Socios)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de la Asamblea)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200–3,800 per year (registered office address, in-country compliance agent, and legal representative services in Bogotá or Medellín)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500–7,500 per year for a private single-family-office holding with investment portfolio and no public interest (local Colombian firm; Big Four range USD 8,000–20,000)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holidays. Available preferential regimes are sector-specific, e.g., the Zona Franca special rate of 20% for qualifying operations, the 25% deduction for long-term productive investment, and R&D tax incentives. A passive single family office normally does not qualify for these; the effective tax rate remains 35% on taxable net income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 210 — Declaración de Renta y Complementarios para Personas Jurídicas; e-filed through the DIAN Muisca portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (tax year is the calendar year; no quarterly corporate income tax filing requirement).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For tax year ending 31 December, the return is due according to the DIAN annual Resolution schedule, generally between July and September of the following year, based on the last digit of the NIT. For fiscal years ending on a date other than 31 December, the return is due within six months of the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification number of the S.A.S. single family office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Colombian NIT assigned to the SFO. Non-resident parents or shareholders are not listed in this field, but their identification must be declared in the economic-relationship annexure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross Colombian-source income, including dividends, interest, capital gains, and any other passive income generated through the family portfolio.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Colombian-source income unless the SFO is a tax resident and is required to include foreign-source income under CFC rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible expenses directly attributable to income generation, such as professional management fees, custody fees, and operational costs of the family office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border charges require documentary evidence, beneficial owner statements, and must satisfy arm's-length substance requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after statutory adjustments and deductions, including depreciation and exempt income not yet excluded.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure dividends already subject to corporate taxation are properly excluded from this line to avoid double taxation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable base after all adjustments, including tax-loss carryforwards subject to the 25% annual offset limit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot offset personal losses against the SFO's taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 49 — Impuesto de renta a cargo
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Self-assessed income tax, generally 35% of line 46, before credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply only tax treaty credits if a Colombian DTA is invoked and documentation is retained.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 58 — Saldo a pagar o a favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final balance due or refundable tax, after prepayments, tax credits, and withholdings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An excess credit can be claimed through the DIAN refund and compensation procedure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing under Article 641 E.T. imposes a penalty of 5% of tax due if filed within 6 months after the deadline, 10% if filed between 6 and 12 months, and 15% if filed later. If no tax is due, fixed penalty in UVT. Unpaid tax accrues default interest at the government borrowing rate. Criminal exposure may arise for intentional non-filing or fraudulent returns.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends remitted to non-resident shareholders from profits already taxed at the 35% corporate income tax rate; 35% withholding if dividends are distributed from profits not subjected to corporate income tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a treaty-reduced dividend withholding rate, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from the Comisión tributaria of its jurisdiction, provide a beneficial ownership declaration to the SFO, and submit the documentation before each distribution. The withholding agent must retain the TRC and supporting files. No advance DIAN approval is required; if excess withholding occurs, the non-resident may file a refund application with DIAN.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest paid to non-residents is generally subject to a 30% statutory withholding tax, reduced to 15% for loans from foreign financial institutions and to treaty rates under applicable DTAs. Royalties from intellectual property and technology are subject to a 30% statutory withholding tax; reduced rates may apply under double tax treaties (commonly 5% to 10%). Management or technical service fees may fall under a separate 10% withholding category when they qualify as services under Colombian tax rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: COP 4,706,500,000 (100,000 UVT for fiscal year 2024) in gross income or total assets, or related-party transactions equal to or exceeding COP 470,650,000 (10,000 UVT), triggering Local File and Master File obligations and the TP return annex.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia enforces economic substance through general anti-avoidance rules, CFC legislation under Law 2277 of 2022, and controlled-transaction analysis. A single family office must demonstrate real physical presence, active management, payroll, and commercial rationale for each transaction to avoid re-characterisation as a shamming arrangement. The SFO's Medium-Risk Enhanced AML profile further requires an active corporate, banking, and compliance footprint.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing a Form 210 that omits Colombian-source income, inflates deductions, or utilises forged invoices to reduce taxable income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalty for tax evasion under Article 447-A of the Colombian Criminal Code, as amended by Law 2277 of 2022: imprisonment of 4 to 9 years plus fines and asset forfeiture. Administrative sanction is equal to 200% of the tax evaded.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the ultimate beneficial owner of the SFO become jointly and severally liable for the civil tax debt and may face travel bans, asset restraint, and detention pending trial if the misuse of the corporate veil is proven.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating a Colombian S.A.S. without genuine business premises, staff, or economic operations, or using the SFO to conceal family assets from creditors, tax authorities, or foreign courts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may disregard the entity for tax purposes and impose the fine under Article 647 E.T. equal to 3% of the shareholder equity stated in the return or 1% of the improperly deducted amounts. Judicial nullity of the sham vehicle's contracts can follow.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners face personal civil liability for all omitted corporate taxes and interest, plus criminal liability for fraudulent simulation with possible imprisonment of 48 to 108 months and property confiscation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to implement a Single Family Office AML manual, not reporting suspicious transactions to UIAF, or executing private-banking and securities-custody transfers without verifying the beneficial owner and source of funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law 526 of 1999 and Superfinanciera Circular 004 of 2021, penalties may reach COP 3.4 billion for severe violations, cancellation of the SFO's authorisation to operate, and seizure of funds linked to illicit assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives are personally subject to administrative fines, disqualification from commercial activity for up to 10 years, and criminal prosecution for money laundering under Article 323 of Law 599 of 2000, which carries prison penalties of 9 to 15 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Non-Filing / Thin Capitalisation Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the transfer pricing annexure, not preparing Local File or Master File documentation, or executing interest or royalty payments to related parties at non-arm's-length rates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 260-10 E.T., DIAN may apply a fine equal to 10% of the non-deductible adjustment and 20% of the omitted tax, plus penalties for incomplete documentation. Unjustified thin capitalisation may result in the disallowance of interest deductions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative signing the disclosure is personally liable for penalties arising from deliberate non-cooperation with DIAN, and could face disqualification as an administrator and personal tax debt attachment.
